g.text: • A mandatory human who leads the Digital Team
• Decides goals, strategy, what cannot be undone
• Delegated to coordinate, never to approve by itself
• Reads every command or action before it runs
• No judgment, so it cannot be talked out of a rule
Operator speaks to every lane and Pilot directly.
